description_en: Queries the health status of backend servers
description_zh: 查询后端服务器的健康状态
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-health-status --load-balancer-id lb-bp1qjwo61pqz3ah0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHealthStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port that is used by the SLB instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

If you do not specify this parameter, the health status of all ports is returned
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。
取值：1~65535

不设置该参数表示获取所有端口的健康检查状态
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en: The frontend protocol that is used by the SLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的协议
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

ListenerPort.description_en: The frontend port that is used by the SLB instance
ListenerPort.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口

Port.description_en: The backend port that is used by the SLB instance
Port.description_zh: 负载均衡实例后端使用的端口

Protocol.description_en: The frontend protocol that is used by the SLB instance
Protocol.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的协议

ServerHealthStatus.description_en:
The health status of the backend server. Valid values:

normal: The backend server is healthy.

abnormal: The backend server is unhealthy.

unavailable: The health check is not completed
ServerHealthStatus.description_zh:
后端服务器的健康状况。

normal：后端服务器健康。
abnormal：后端服务器不健康。
unavailable：未完成健康检查

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the backend server

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the backend server
